pose: A perfectly centered, intimate portrait. The REF_DAKOTARAPTOR_ADULT is standing completely still, facing the viewer with a curious, friendly head-tilt. It is looking directly down at the REF_ORODROMEUS_ADULT, who is sprawled on its back in the foreground with cartoon 'X' eyes. The camera is high-angle, looking down. The Dakotaraptor's full face, eyes, and beak are prominent and sharply in focus as it inspects the Orodromeus. The background is a shallow-focus, dappled forest floor.

render_parameters.negative_constraints: No dynamic motion blur, strictly standing and looking down, no aggressive posture, no negative space, absolute edge-to-edge 1:1 composition
